_note: Approximate times of public events around the SVB failure, from official press releases and news coverage. Shown on the dashboard timeline for context only: they are not part of the data and the monitor never uses them.

markers.label: SVB announces loss
markers.note: After the US close, SVB says it sold bonds at a $1.8bn loss and plans a $2.25bn share sale.

markers.label: SVB shares collapse
markers.note: US market opens. SVB shares end the day down about 60% as depositors pull their money.

markers.label: SVB closed
markers.note: US morning: California regulators close SVB and appoint the FDIC as receiver.

markers.label: Joint statement
markers.note: Sunday evening: Treasury, Fed and FDIC say all SVB depositors will be protected; Signature Bank is closed.

markers.label: Regional banks fall
markers.note: US open: regional bank shares fall sharply; First Republic drops about 60% on the day.
